name: Joe Diamond
title: The Private Investigator
ability: Forced - When the investigation phase begins: Reveal the top card of your hunch deck. Until the end of the phase, you may play that card as if it were in your hand, at -2 cost. If it is still revealed at the end of the phase, shuffle it back into your hunch deck. [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move an [[Insight]] event from your discard pile to the bottom of your hunch deck.
ability_cn: 强制 - 在调查阶段开始时：翻开你的直觉牌组顶部的卡牌。本阶段结束前，你可以以-2费用打出该卡牌，如同其为你的手牌。如果当本阶段结束时该卡牌未被打出，将其混洗回你的直觉牌组。 [elder_sign]效果:+1。你可以将你弃牌堆的1张[[洞察]]事件卡移动到你直觉牌组底部。
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果:+1。你可以将你弃牌堆的1张
back_text: Deck Size: 40. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Detective's Colt 1911s, Unsolved Case, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 11 [[Insight]] events (including Unsolved Case). During the setup of each scenario, you must choose 11 [[Insight]] events from your deck (one of which must be Unsolved Case) and shuffle them into a separate "hunch deck".
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：40。 牌组构建选项：探求者([seeker])等级0-5，守卫者([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：侦探的柯尔特1911式手枪、悬案、1张随机基础弱点。 附加需求：你的牌组必须包括至少11张[[洞察]]事件(包括悬案)。在每场冒险的设置期间，你必须从你牌组中选择11张[[洞察]]事件(其中必须包括悬案)并将其混洗为一个单独的"直觉牌组"。
